title: Sakina ne kaha baba chacha ab tak nahi aaye
body:
Sakeena ne kaha baba chacha ab tak nahi aaye
Rawa ashko ka hai darya chacha ab tak nahi aaye
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Na mangoongi kabhi paani mere ammu se ye kahdo
Jaha ne hai sitam dhaya  chacha ab tak nahi aaye
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Mere baba ko tanhaayi me hai ghera layino ne
Hua mera pidar tanha  chacha ab tak nahi aaye
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Khadi hu berida aur mere mazloom baba ka
Padha hai be kafan lasha  chacha ab tak nahi aaye
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Dara ta hai mujhe durre se zalim mere rone par
Nikal jaayega dam mera  chacha ab tak nahi aaye
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Chine kaano se gohar aur tamaache bhi lage mujhko
Jalaya hai mera kurta chacha ab tak nahi aaye
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Khayamat aati thi anwar jo roke kahti thi dukhiya
Bhara ghar lut gaya mera chacha ab tak nahi aaye
